name: Ignition
objectiveText: Get the Ignition Key and bring it to Wizzlecrank. Ignition Key  ( 1 )

comments.body: Wizzle crank is at approximatly 56,8, just north of the tower next to another smocking wreck. If he's not there, someone else has just done escape and he'll be back in two minutes.
replies: It's definitely more like a 10 minute wait.
I timed it now, and it's exactly 10 minutes from someone starts the quest until he respawns.

comments.body:
You can pick up this quest at Sludge Fen around 56,8.
Talk to the guy inside the Shredder. (He is just on the outside of the water's edge)
Get the key from the little green superviser on the platform in the middle of the water.
Bring it back to the guy in the Shredder.
Escort him (the Shredder) just up the hill until the machine dies.
Your last stop is in Ratchet to complete this series of quests.

Good luck
replies:
If you are willing to do two corpse runs from the Crossroads, this quest is very easy to complete.

After acquiring the quest from the Shredder goblin, unequip all your armor and weapons.  Then head to the middle of the lake underneath the tower and let yourself get killed by the first guard.

Run back to the tower but don't immediately res at your body.  Instead take your ghost to the very top of the tower (ghosts are locked to only horizontal location on the map), and resurrect inside the control room.

Buff up and wait for the goblin supervisor to enter the control room.  Whe

There is usually a 19 elite (silver) inside the control room, so a bad place to res. Unfortunately most other places around to res there have about three critters on you faster than you can regain mana and health. It's not that hard to fight your way through, just tedious. Half of the time they will run off to the already cleared direction anyway. And you can jump down in the water to avoid fighting your way out.

comments.body:
Fairly straight forward. Go up the ramp of the big structure in the water. Be careful of roamers, there's 2-3 of them that go back and forth, so keep an eye out.

The key is on Supervisor Lugwizzle. He roams up and down the ramp and around a bit of the shore of the water. He even passes by Wizzlecrank, so if you're lucky, you can finish this quest fairly quickly.
the key drops off supervisor lugwizzle who is just up the ramp of the tower in the muck pool of the sludge fern where all the venture co miners and mercenaries are.  He is level 18.

Unless by a strange bug or something, this quest does not seem to work for groups. Solo only perhaps? I was in a party prior to accepting this quest, when the NPC spawned, I obtained the quest, however the rest of my party did not, nor was it shareable.

EDIT: There was one other person who was not in our group that also started the quest at the same time I did.
replies: They must have fixed this bug in the new WoW Classic. I did the escort with a 5 man group and we all got credit -- like any other escort.

The named supervisor (can't remember name, but not elite - level 18) wanders around the derrick, so you can wait for him on the bottom level.  Spacing is tighter here than on the outside area, so aggro of multiple mobs is almost completely unavoidable.  Mobs run early, so earthbind totem is MANDATORY by shamans.

56,8 TBLoc 
On the Ramp of the tower.

You need to accept the quest from [b]Wizzlecrank's Shredder[/b] north of the oil platform, if it's not there someone might be on the escort or they finished it and there's a short respawn (5-10min). After you accept the quest you need to then go up the oil platform and kill [b]Supervisor Lugwizzle[/b] for the [b]ignition key[/b]. 

He will not drop the key unless you have the quest.
